provenance_history.mariette_1872: The collective place-name Tmaï-el-Amdîd covered two neighboring ancient cities/mounds, Thmuis and Mendes. Therefore early labels using Tmaï-el-Amdîd or Thmuis-Mendes are geographically ambiguous rather than secure Mendes/Tell el-Rub'a provenances.
provenance_history.british_library_c1871: Délié & Béchard photograph 74/559*g.21(22) is catalogued as a group of silver bowls and other objects from Thmuis, Lower Egypt, in the Bulaq Museum.
provenance_history.modern_colburn_2020: Bissing 3581-3583 are three silver phialai excavated at Tell Timai, ancient Thmuis, by Emile Brugsch in 1871; Bissing 3584-3585 are also treated as Tell Timai Achaemenid silver bowls.

chronology_correction.3581_3583: Achaemenid-type silver phialai, probably 5th century BCE rather than Ptolemaic
chronology_correction.3584_3585: Achaemenid-type silver bowls, broadly 5th-4th century BCE
chronology_correction.boundary: Individual museum/exhibition catalogues may preserve older Ptolemaic dating; modern typological redating does not alter findspot correction.

morphology_control.3582: shallow silver bowl, ca. 3 cm high and ca. 16.5 cm wide, rounded bottom, low sloping rim, rosette and Nymphaea/lily-petal decoration
morphology_control.3583: similar shallow silver bowl/phiale with related floral ornament
morphology_control.3584: silver bowl/cup (Napf), ca. 8.6 cm high and 18 cm wide, rounded body with separated neck, rosette and large lotus-bud decoration
morphology_control.3585: silver bowl/cup (Napf), ca. 8.7 cm high and 14.7 cm wide, rounded body and high wide neck, rosette and petal decoration
morphology_control.bissing_cult_equipment_note: Bissing suggested the 3584-like form probably belonged among cult equipment; this is a historical interpretation, not evidence of an Osirian genital/relic function.

research_consequence.reason: Thmuis/Tell Timai is geographically close to Mendes and participates in overlapping regional cult history, but regional/cult association is not the same as a Mendes findspot.
research_consequence.search_reset: Return material search to securely provenanced Tell el-Rub'a/Mendes temple, dromos, necropolis and associated museum inventories.
